reviewFlags.issue: Sources conflict on power: Spacenet and M.K. Electronics list 500 W, while a Tunisian listing titled Blender Moulinex Genuine LM240B25 / 450W gives 450 W. Check the box or the regional label.

Catalog says 1.75 L total jar capacity and 1.25 L working capacity. M.K. Electronics says 1.75 LTR jar, but Spacenet says 1.25L mixer capacity. Tunisian listings give 1.5 L. Verify on the physical product.

No manufacturer, Moulinex Israel or importer page names LM240B25. The model appears only on retailer listings in Tunisia and Bangladesh, which suggests a non-Israeli regional variant. The Israeli variant and plug rating are unclear.
The catalog name says 500 וואט and 1.75 ליטר, which matches only one of the conflicting retailer sources. Check the name against the manufacturer's sheet once a manufacturer page is found.
Catalog gives a 220-240V range. The only quote found says 230 Volts from a Bangladeshi retailer. Confirm the mains voltage for the Israeli unit.
Catalog claims 4 Zelkrom blades. No source found confirms the blade count or the Zelkrom name.
Only Tunisian and Bangladeshi retailer pages name LM240B25; no manufacturer or Israeli importer page. Israeli variant and plug type unclear.
Researcher reported another Tunisian listing at 450 W. Confirm power on the unit label.
Catalog 1.25 L working capacity matches Spacenet's 'mixer capacity 1.25L' but is not confirmed as working capacity; other listings mention 1.5 L.
Catalog claims 4 Zelkrom blades; no source confirms blade count or Zelkrom name.
